a.lede: An international visa program has for years allowed US tech companies to hire highly skilled workers from abroad.
a.title: White House blocks Microsoft from foreign worker hiring program

b.lede: U.S. suspends green card path for H-1B workers at Microsoft, Adobe, and IT outsourcing companies — PERM program blocked due to alleged fraud
b.title: U.S. suspends green card path for H-1B workers at Microsoft and Adobe — labor certification program blocked due to alleged fraud
